description: Convert an image to WebP, AVIF, JPEG or PNG, resize it and compress it. Strips EXIF by default, applies EXIF rotation, keeps animation for GIF/WebP sources. Returns the file with before/after sizes. Price: $0.01 USDC via x402, charged only on success. Part of Image tools: Everyday image work for sites and apps: convert and compress to WebP/AVIF/JPEG/PNG, responsive srcset sets with ready <picture> markup, colour palettes, pixel diffs for visual regression, SVG to PNG, QR codes, blur placeholders, and an inspection that says what to fix before shipping an image..

background.description: Colour behind transparency. JPEG has no alpha, so it defaults to white there.

fit.description: inside: fit within the box, keep aspect; cover: fill the box and crop; contain: fit and pad with background.

image.description: Image file as base64 (PNG, JPEG, WebP, AVIF, GIF, TIFF or SVG).

keepMetadata.description: Keep EXIF/ICC. Off by default: strips location and camera data.

lossless.description: WebP/AVIF lossless mode; PNG keeps full colour.

quality.description: Lossy quality. For PNG, under 100 switches to a palette PNG (much smaller).

upscale.description: Allow making the image larger than the source.

width.description: Target width in pixels. With only one of width/height the other follows the aspect ratio.

name: image_tools_convert
